Definition: from G5411; to have a burden, i.e. (by analogy) to wear as clothing or a constant accompaniment:--bear, wear.
BiblicalUsage: Phoreo means to wear, to bear as clothing, and it appears where what a man wears tells who he is. As we have borne the image of the earthy, Paul says, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly, and Jesus comes forth wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, while He says that they who wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that what we wear is what we bear: the image of the earthy now, the image of the heavenly then, and the King in thorns between them.
